description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AndroidBaseXmlRefactoringAction' that extends 'BaseRefactoringAction'. It provides functionality for refactoring XML tags within Android development in IntelliJ IDEA, including methods for checking applicability, handling selections, and performing refactoring actions on XML tags in Android projects.

classes.name: AndroidBaseXmlRefactoringAction
classes.description: An abstract class providing XML refactoring actions specific to Android development within IntelliJ IDEA.

methods.name: isAvailableOnElementInEditorAndFile
methods.description: Checks if refactoring is available on the given element in the editor and file.

methods.name: getNonEmptySelectionRange
methods.description: Returns the non-empty text range selected in the editor, if any.

methods.name: getExtractableRange
methods.description: Determines the range of PSI elements that can be extracted based on start and end offsets.

methods.name: isEnabledOnElements
methods.description: Checks if the refactoring can be enabled on the provided PSI elements.

methods.name: isEnabledForTags
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if refactoring is enabled for given XML tags.

methods.name: isEnabledForPsiRange
methods.description: Determines if refactoring is enabled for a range of PSI elements.

methods.name: isAvailableForLanguage
methods.description: Checks if the language is XML.

methods.name: isAvailableForFile
methods.description: Checks if the file is an XML file associated with Android and suitable for refactoring.

methods.name: isMyFile
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the file is the target file type.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the action's presentation based on context.

methods.name: doRefactorForTags
methods.description: Abstract method to perform refactoring on specified XML tags.

methods.name: doRefactorForPsiRange
methods.description: Performs refactoring on a range of PSI elements.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Returns a refactoring handler based on the current data context.

methods.name: isAvailableInEditorOnly
methods.description: Indicates whether the action is available only in the editor.

methods.name: getXmlTagsFromExternalContext
methods.description: Retrieves XML tags from external context providers.
